card.name: Linking words in renal and radiopharmaceutical text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, of, to) or an opening parenthesis just before a technical term. Seen in the kidney-excretion sentence "glomerular filtration and active tubular secretion" and in radiopharmaceutical preparation steps.

modes.label: Kidney excretion sentence
modes.description: The word "and" or "of" inside "a combination of glomerular filtration and active tubular secretion".
modes.example: Because FTC and tenofovir are primarily excreted by the kidneys by a combination of glomerular filtration<< and>> active tubular secretion

modes.label: Radiopharmaceutical prep
modes.description: A linking word before pertechnetate or a receptor name in imaging-agent instructions.
modes.example: into a syringe containing 555 MBq to 740 MBq (15 mCi to 20 mCi)<< of>> sodium pertechnetate Tc

modes.label: Parenthesis before abbreviation
modes.description: An opening parenthesis before an abbreviation after a long receptor name.
modes.example: may interfere with the endosomal neonatal Fc receptor<< (>>FcRn) recycling mechanism of monoc
